Name: /review
Benefit: Runs an RBAC/test-coverage-focused review before committing backend changes
column3: catching permission and docs/code mismatches before they ship.

Name: PostToolUse pytest hook
Benefit: Automatically runs the backend test suite after every backend edit so regressions are caught immediately instead of at the next manual test run.

Name: File size limit hook warning
Benefit: Warns as soon as an edited file exceeds ~200 lines so oversized files get split before they become hard to review or maintain.

Name: Task management (tasks/todo.md)
Benefit: Forces a written plan/checklist before non-trivial work
column3: making progress and scope visible instead of tracked only in conversation.

Name: Self-improvement loop (tasks/lessons.md)
Benefit: Records past mistakes so the same corrected error is not repeated in a later session.

Name: Verify before done
Benefit: Requires actually running tests/build/manual checks before marking work complete
column3: preventing "looks right" code from being reported as done.

Name: File size limit (~200 lines)
Benefit: Keeps files small by splitting logic into new files/functions
column3: improving readability and reducing merge/review friction.

Name: Error boundaries (ErrorBoundary.jsx)
Benefit: Contains a failure in one part of the UI so it does not crash the entire frontend app.

Name: Simplicity & no duplication
Benefit: Prevents redundant helpers/components/queries by requiring reuse of existing patterns documented in docs/conventions.md.

Name: Docs vs. code conflict rule
Benefit: Ensures the actual code is trusted over stale docs and any mismatch is flagged rather than silently "fixed" or ignored.

Name: Don't guess ports/URLs rule
Benefit: Prevents wrong ports/URLs from being assumed from stale files by requiring docs/deployment.md as the single source of truth.

Name: Performance / context loading rule
Benefit: Avoids wasted context by only reading files/docs actually needed for the current task.

Name: JWT secret startup guard
Benefit: Fails the app loudly at startup if the default JWT secret is left unset
column3: preventing forgeable tokens from ever reaching production.

Name: CORS allow-list (no wildcard)
Benefit: Restricts which frontend origins can call the API
column3: preventing arbitrary sites from making authenticated cross-origin requests.

Name: Production reload/debug removed from Dockerfile
Benefit: Stops the production server from auto-reloading or leaking debug behavior in a deployed environment.
